hero.caption: A panoramic photograph of Kanawha Falls on the Kanawha River, just downstream from the river's origin at Gauley Bridge in Fayette County, WV. Image compiled with Autostitch from 12 individual photographs, taken with a Panasonic Lumix DMC-FZ50 mounted to a Panosaurus tripod head.
